name: harvest-mcp
description: Harvest API integration — time entries, projects, tasks, clients, expenses, invoices, team assignments, and reports. Delete operations disabled for safety.

account_id.title: Harvest Account ID
account_id.description: Your Harvest account ID (visible at id.getharvest.com/developers)

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries with filters (date, project, user, etc.)

tools.name: get_time_entry
tools.description: Get a specific time entry by ID

tools.name: create_time_entry
tools.description: Create a new time entry or start a timer

tools.name: list_project_task_assignments
tools.description: List tasks assigned to a project

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get a specific task by ID

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a specific user by ID

tools.name: get_expense
tools.description: Get a specific expense by ID

tools.name: get_expense_category
tools.description: Get an expense category by ID

tools.name: list_all_user_assignments
tools.description: List all user assignments across projects

tools.name: list_project_user_assignments
tools.description: List user assignments for a project

tools.name: create_project_user_assignment
tools.description: Assign a user to a project

tools.name: time_report_by_team
tools.description: Time report grouped by team members

tools.name: project_budget_report
tools.description: Project budget vs spent vs remaining

tools.name: expense_report_by_team
tools.description: Expense report grouped by team members

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by client, project, state, or date

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get a specific invoice with its line items

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new draft invoice for a client

tools.name: create_invoice_from_time
tools.description: Create a draft invoice from unbilled tracked time and expenses by project

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update an existing invoice and its line items

tools.name: list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded against an invoice

tools.name: record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record a received payment against an invoice (bookkeeping only)

prompts.name: log-time
prompts.description: Guided workflow to create a time entry
prompts.text: Help me log a time entry in Harvest. Guide me through picking a project, task, duration, and notes, then create the entry.

prompts.name: weekly-summary
prompts.text: Generate a summary of my time entries for the week, grouped by project and client. Show daily breakdown and highlight gaps.

prompts.name: timer
prompts.description: Start, stop, or check timer status
prompts.text: Manage my Harvest timer — start a new timer, stop the running one, or check current timer status.
